headline: DEFENDER can kill you again
lede: The respawn grace froze at ~2 seconds after the first crash — every collision check was false forever, GAME OVER was unreachable, and the WATCH patrol's four-batch "all 40 seeds survive" witness law turned out to be an artifact of that immortality. #3445 burns the grace honestly: ~1 s dark, ~2 s blinking, then you are mortal, exactly as the arcade promised.

notes.text: One honest line in sim.js plus new §grace laws: the grace burns to zero on the clock alone, a second crash lands nudged-free, and hands-down ArrowDown reaches GAME OVER — pinned in Node, driven in real Chrome (lives ladder 3>2>1>0, restart clean), and the smart-bomb batch's by-name pin in defenderplay inverted exactly as it promised. Merged a6c8982 after rebasing over #3443.

WITNESS re-pinned to honest mortal floors (a real GAME OVER on >=15/20 seeds per set; banks, waves, rescues), the never-die direction pinned too, and two law tests hardened — hauler-rank decided by steer side, delivery elevator pinned directly — so loosened totals still kill the b19 mutants. Crash-leg budgets moved to WORLD ticks after multi-lane frame starvation (~5 tps) flaked a wall-clock ceiling.
b20/b21 measured nine interception designs — every one against a half-immortal pilot. All nine verdicts need re-reading before any survival claim returns to the copy; the arc is open as #3456.

look.text: DEFENDER — the planet is lethal again: fly it
